findings.text: The done_when requires the matched arms to run as an all_debug partition job, but the worker's stream shows the base and after arms ran as plain Bash inside the fleet allocation (job 1291586) and the log headers name only a /tmp scratch tree with no partition; the measurement is complete and readable, yet the venue clause is unmet and should be re-produced on all_debug if that clause is load-bearing.

The duty assertion pins only the negative (kind != 'run-queued' and no position), so a regression that gave the launched pointer a different but still wrong duty would pass; asserting the duty the manifest implies (the finished run's promotion) would make the test guard the goal's positive half.

The final assertion rereads the pointer the fixture itself wrote and compares its phase to a literal, so it holds whatever the production change does and adds no guard; it is a fixture self-check rather than coverage of the defect.

The docstring says the test asserts the row's own classification is the queued one, but the body asserts only queue_admission.awaits_a_lane_slot and a fixture phase read; no classification row is examined, so the docstring overstates what the test covers.
